prior_passes.notes: Could not source this specific 27km 'Fayoum-Giza Gas Pipeline.' Ruled out: it is NOT one of the three lines in Ministry of Petroleum Decree 1884/2025 (those total 40.5km across Beni Suef-New Fayoum/19km, Fayoum-expansion-support/12km, and Itsa-supply/9.5km -- all already accounted for as P6686/P8012/P8011, none named Giza); and it is NOT the Solaimaneyah-North Giza line (Decree 1883/2025, 20km, a different corridor through Giza/Monufia governorates along the Regional Ring Road -- that is P6685). Searched English and Arabic (خط غاز الفيوم الجيزة, GASCO/EGAS project pages, Egyptian press, official-gazette search) with no hit on a discrete decree, GASCO project page, or news item describing a 27km Fayoum-to-Giza gas line. gem.wiki has no page yet for this pipeline (blank), so no internal lead there either. Speculative/unsourced corridor guess only: given the naming convention (GASCO/Ministry lines are routinely named '<place A>-<place B>'), this is plausibly a link between the Fayoum distribution network (e.g. the Fayoum-Giza desert road corridor near Demu/New Fayoum City, see P8012's start) and a point in rural Giza Governorate's Nile-valley markaz (Atfih/Badrashin/El-Saff), which would roughly fit a 27km span -- but this is not sourced and should not be treated as more than a hypothesis for a follow-up search (e.g. querying the Egyptian Official Gazette portal directly, or GASCO/EGAS annual reports, for a 'Fayoum-Giza' or similarly named decree).

prior_passes.notes: The pipeline itself is now IDENTIFIED and independently verified (I downloaded and text-extracted the PDF myself and confirmed the exact line): EGAS Annual Report 2018 (egyptoil-gas.com), page 20 of the PDF, table 'NATIONAL GAS GRID PIPELINES UNDER CONSTRUCTION DURING 2017/2018' — 'Project Rehabilitation gas supply pipeline 24" Fayoum / Giza 27 km', target end date December 2018 — listed alongside other real, GEM-tracked onshore trunk segments (Dahshur/AlWaste 68.5km, Ezdwaj Edku/Abu Houmas 30km, AlWaste/Beni Suef 60km, Tina/Abu Sultan 92km). The 24-inch diameter and 27km length match the sheet's recorded attributes exactly, strongly indicating this IS the sheet's own underlying (uncited-in-our-payload) source. This rules out the prior pass's exhaustive negative search (Ministry Decrees 1883/1884, Solaimaneyah-North Giza) — this is a THIRD, separate EGAS rehabilitation project not covered by those decrees. HOWEVER the report names only the governorates 'Fayoum' and 'Giza' with no station, town, or landmark for either end, so no defensible endpoint coordinates can be derived without guessing at a specific place — hence still unresolved for geometry. One unconfirmed lead worth flagging: the same report separately lists 'Giza West' as one of 9 sites where land was purchased for pressure-reduction stations (PRSs) under a DIFFERENT, unrelated IBRD/AFD-funded household gas-connection project (p.23 of the PDF) — a real, named place in Giza Governorate, but not confirmed to be the same project/pipeline as this 24in/27km rehabilitation line. Do not confuse this pipeline with an unrelated ~69km offshore 'Fayoum'/'Giza' gas-field-to-Rosetta-plant project (West Nile Delta) — different length/diameter, does not match this PID's recorded attributes. Recommend a follow-up search specifically for 'Giza West' PRS location or an EGAS/GASCO tender/as-built document naming the exact 27km rehabilitation route before attempting geometry.
